description: Summarize workspace analytics for a timeframe (for example 30d) or a startDate/endDate range, for workspace_id. summary.platformMetrics holds the per-channel metrics used to compare channels. One call covers one range; a trend comes from comparing two separate ranges. Read-only.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_get_analytics_summary
title: Get Analytics Summary
